content_sections.heading: ESIC Teaching Faculty Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC), Ministry of Labour & Employment, Government of India has officially released dated 24-07-2026 for the recruitment of 59 Teaching Faculty, Senior Resident, and Tutor posts at ESIC Medical College & Hospital, Pandeypur, Varanasi . The notification contains complete details regarding post-wise vacancies, eligibility criteria, age limit, salary, application fee, selection process, required documents, interview schedule, and application procedure. Eligible candidates are advised to read the official notification carefully before submitting their application. The official notification is available on the ESIC website. content_sections.heading: ESIC Varanasi Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 10 Professor , 13 Associate Professor , 11 Assistant Professor , and 15 Senior Resident posts (49 posts in total) are notified across 20 departments, along with 10 Tutor posts. The category-wise vacancy break-up for each post is given below.

content_sections.heading: Important Provision on Reserved Category Posts
content_sections.text: As highlighted in the notification, any candidate can be appointed against an unfilled vacant reserved category post for 44 days, with a provision for possible extension. Candidates from the unreserved category can apply against EWS vacancies.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Varanasi Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Teaching Faculty (Professor/Associate Professor/Assistant Professor): 69 years (not exceeding) Senior Resident: Up to 45 years Tutor: Up to 40 years The maximum tenure of engagement will be till the candidate attains 70 years of age for teaching faculty, whichever is earlier, provided other rules and regulations are satisfied. Educational qualifications for all posts are as per NMC (MCI) guidelines, as stipulated in Gazette Notification No. CG-DL-E-05072025-264399 dated 30.06.2025. The notification does not specify post-wise degree requirements beyond this reference; candidates should refer to the applicable NMC regulations for their respective specialty. Reservation will be as per Government of India guidelines issued from time to time. As per EWS guidelines, EWS posts are not carried forward. In case of non-availability of an EWS candidate, other category candidates may be allowed provisionally to apply, subject to being considered as UR candidates, with selection made purely on merit. In case of non-availability of reserved category candidates for an advertised post, the vacancy may be filled for less than 45 days as a de-reserved seat. All candidates must have updated Medical Registration (NMC/State Medical Council) for all post-MBBS/MD/MS qualifications. If registration is not updated, candidates must show "Applied for document(s)" proof at the time of interview; failing this, they may not be interviewed, or their result may be withheld. Selected candidates must submit the updated Medical Registration Certificate at the time of joining. Candidates working in Government/Autonomous/Statutory institutions should preferably carry a "No Objection Certificate (NOC)" from their employer at the time of interview; if unavailable, a copy of the "applied for NOC" should be submitted. No private practice is allowed in any capacity after joining as teaching faculty at ESIC Medical College, Pandeypur, Varanasi. Reservation for PH (Divyangjan) candidates will be maintained as per Government of India norms.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Varanasi Teaching Faculty Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Pay and allowances are as per OM No. Z-11012/51/2022-Med VI dated 08.12.2022: In the case of engagement of retired employees/pensioners, they may be allowed to draw total pay without any deduction, as this is not treated as a case of re-employment under the Central Civil Services (Fixation of Pay of Re-Employed Pensioner) Orders, 1986. Such retired employees/pensioners can continue to draw pension and dearness relief on pension during their period of contractual engagement.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Varanasi Recruitment 2026 - Application Fee
content_sections.text: Mode of Payment: Through Demand Draft in favor of "ESI Fund A/c No.-1", payable at Varanasi. The fee, once paid, will not be refunded under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: Terms of Contract
content_sections.text: Tenure of all posts is 1 (one) year, extendable up to 3 years, or attainment of 70 years of age, whichever is earlier. The contractual engagement may be terminated/discontinued from either side by giving one month's prior notice, without assigning any reason. In case of spot resignation by a selected candidate, one month's salary must be deposited to the ESIC account through challan. No claim for service benefits such as PF, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Allowance, Medical Benefits, Seniority, or Promotion will be admissible. Being a contractual appointment, absence from work for a period beyond 7 (seven) days without proper permission of the competent authority will amount to voluntary abandonment of engagement and automatic termination. Teaching faculty are required to mark attendance manually as well as on the Aadhaar Enabled Bio-metric Attendance System (AEBAS) daily during scheduled working days. Other terms and conditions will be applicable as issued by the Competent Authority from time to time.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Varanasi Recruitment 2026 - Required Documents
content_sections.text: Self-attested copies of the following documents must be attached with the application form: Admit Card/Certificate of passing Class 10th for Date of Birth All Mark Sheets, Attempt details, and Degree Certificate of MBBS All Mark Sheets, Attempt details, and Degree Certificate of MD/MS/DNB/Other Examination Valid EWS/OBC/EBC/SC/ST Certificate issued in the format applicable for Central Government jobs, when applicable State/NMC Medical Registration Certificate (updated) Proof of Publication(s), Paper/Poster presentation Experience Certificate Recent Passport size photograph of the candidate Relieving Certificate from previous employer, if applicable Aadhaar Card Completion Certificate of ICMR/NMC conducted Bio-medical research examination, if any NMC-appeared Revised/Basic Medical Education Workshop Completion Certificate, if any All required documents/certificates will be verified against the original document(s)/certificate(s) before the interview and before generation of the offer of appointment.

content_sections.heading: ESIC Varanasi Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made on the basis of the candidate's acquired academic credentials and performance in the interview before the Selection Board. The result will be displayed on the website www.esic.gov.in, and the Offer of Appointment will be sent through email. Selected candidates will have to join as per the instructions mentioned in the offer of appointment. The notification does not mention any written examination as part of the selection process; selection is based on academic credentials and interview performance only.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ESIC Varanasi Teaching Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The scanned application with supporting documents must be emailed to [email protected] by 5:00 PM on 03.08.2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ESIC Varanasi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 49 posts across Professor (10), Associate Professor (13), Assistant Professor (11), and Senior Resident (15) categories, plus 10 Tutor posts, spread across 20 departments. Vacancies are provisional and subject to change.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for ESIC Varanasi Teaching Faculty posts?
faq.answer: As on 03.08.2026, the age limit is 69 years (not exceeding) for teaching faculty, up to 45 years for Senior Resident, and up to 40 years for Tutor.

faq.question: Q4. Is there a written exam for ESIC Varanasi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. According to the notification, selection is based on acquired academic credentials and performance in a walk-in interview before the Selection Board; there is no written examination.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for ESIC Varanasi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Nil for SC/ST/ESIC (Regular Employee)/Female/Defence Ex-servicemen/PH candidates, and Rs. 500/- for all other categories, payable through a Demand Draft in favor of "ESI Fund A/c No.-1" at Varanasi.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Assistant Professor at ESIC Varanasi?
faq.answer: The Assistant Professor post carries a Fixed Basic Pay of Rs. 67,700/- plus other admissible allowances, as per OM No. Z-11012/51/2022-Med VI dated 08.12.2022.

faq.question: Q7. Can retired employees or pensioners apply for ESIC Varanasi Teaching Faculty posts?
faq.answer: Yes. The notification allows engagement of retired employees/pensioners, who may draw total pay without deduction, as this is not treated as re-employment, and they can continue to draw pension and dearness relief during the contractual engagement.

faq.question: Q8. Is TA/DA provided for the ESIC Varanasi interview?
faq.answer: No. As per the notification, no TA/DA will be paid to candidates for appearing in the interview or for submission of any document.
